title: 第15章 家庭教师三第16章 家庭教师四
content_zh:
第15章 家庭教师三
不得不说，某纲觉得自己对于这个来的莫名其妙，开口闭口就是意大利黑手党、彭格列什么的奇奇怪怪的话的家教是个名副其实的祸害啊！
首先是昨晚他可爱的弟弟要求和Reborn一起睡，而那个无节操的婴儿竟然没有犹豫就同意了，甚至还大大方方的在律的怀里找了个合适的位置…
其次今天律天没亮就轻手轻脚的起床去给Reborn做便当…而一向睡眠质量高的他一夜没有阖眼，自然发现了…
满腹怨气的阿纲挂着一幅大大的黑眼圈，整个人无精打采。就连早饭是他最喜欢的海带汤也没能成功让他的心情好上一点。
律自然发现了阿纲周身的气氛，那气息强烈到想忽略都难…
于是关切的问候，“哥哥昨晚没睡好吗？我做了便当，是哥哥最喜欢的鲜虾寿司哦！”
阿纲听到律的关心已然平复了些许，当听到便当是做给自己的，还是自己最喜欢的鲜虾寿司时，立刻加血完毕，整个人都容光焕发起来。
然后当看到Reborn也有一份便当时，也觉得不足以影响自己的好心情了。
见阿纲终于恢复了正常，律总算是松了口气。
想着某只银发忠犬就要到来，而阿纲就要第一次裸奔，律不自觉的露出一抹坏笑。啊咧，真是很期待啊~
自己果然有点恶趣味呢~不过，身心愉悦有助于健康，不是吗？
如愿的，和阿纲一个班的某律见到了亲爱的忠犬狱寺。
看着那个在讲台上一脸别扭的少年，律的嘴角翘起一抹邪恶的弧度。自己现在和阿纲的座位离得很近，只不过一个在中间，一个在临窗。
撒，亲爱的少年，你要怎么选择呢，从两个长得一模一样的人中，找出泽田纲。
千万不要让我失望哟。
狱寺没有直接动作，而是正常上课，带着一脸的不耐烦等到下课，同学们都离开后才站起来。
狱寺环视了一圈，最后将实现定在律和阿纲身上。他没有浮躁的直接上前，而是观察了一下两人，最后得出结论般笔直走向律。
律有些失望，难道自己想错了吗？
但是走到面前的狱寺接下来的动作让他的嘴角勾起了一丝弧度。

狱寺迅速制住律的双手，将一把小刀抵在了他的颈间。
然后向惊慌的阿纲道，“泽田纲吉，在学校后面和我决斗。不答应的话…”
手上的刀向律的脖颈贴近了几分，将细嫩的皮肤划破了一点，一丝血顺着线条优美的颈项滑落下来。律倒是一脸无所谓，反正不怎么疼，而且他细心的注意到狱寺的手微不可查的往外移了移，看来弄伤他是无意的呢。
再说，和云雀三天两头打架的他如果想要挣脱是再容易不过的事，甚至让他制住也是有意为之，嘛，也没什么特别的意思，只是这阵子太无聊了想要看看戏嘛…
狱寺是不可能做出伤害阿纲的事的，所以律并不担心。反正阿纲都会打动狱寺的，然后他就会在忠犬之路上一直走下去…
所以在看到就要冲过来的阿纲时律仍旧带着安抚的微笑。
“哥哥不用担心，没事的。”
阿纲停下身，咬牙道，“放开小律，我答应你。”
从墙壁里出现的Reborn看到律脖子上的血迹本来无比可爱的脸瞬间阴沉了下来。
他本是想让狱寺给阿纲做守护者，并且给阿纲制造一个磨练的机会，但是，他竟然伤了律…
Reborn也不清楚这个总是为他忙前忙后的少年在他的心里到底是什么位置，他一开始觉得律不可能平白无故的对自己好，绞尽脑汁的想他能从自己身上得到什么。可是无论怎么想，结果都指向一个他一直不想承认，而且也不相信会有的事实————那就是，这个少年，真的只是单纯的喜欢自己，尽心尽力的想为自己做些什么而已。
他不知道也暂时不想去想这个人现在对自己来说算是什么，但是有一点是无法否认的——自己不愿意看到他受伤。
而狱寺竟然伤了他…Reborn感觉自己已经很久没有这么生气了，也很少有什么事或人能够让他宁静无波的心泛起太大的波动，但显然，这个和他相处时间其实并不多的少年做到了。
狱寺的确是绝佳的岚之守护者的人选，但是在那之前…就陪他玩儿一玩儿吧…
于是，让我们提前为可怜的狱寺君掬一把同情泪…
听到阿纲应允了之后狱寺就放开了律，然后很利落的说了一声，“抱歉，没有控制好力道。”
律无奈的看了看怒火值不断上升的阿纲，无奈的扶额。
我说狱寺君，虽然我知道你说的是实话，也的确是想道歉，但是你就不能不要那么别扭吗…面无表情的说这话真的很像是在挑衅啊喂，你没有发觉阿纲看你的眼神已经如此“火辣”了吗？
不过受了点伤的某律还是很坏心的不打算阐明这个事实，虽然很想看一看炸弹满天飞的场面，但是他担心自己再被波及到就不好了，看戏的机会还很多，他要去趟医务室消消毒，再多敲诈几个创可贴…
和阿纲他们说了一声律就离开了，于是当他从医务室里出来准备去找阿纲和Reborn一起回家的时候，就无比惊悚的看到了一个人形木乃伊。

看着神清气爽的阿纲和笑而不语的Reborn，律迟疑的说出一个令他觉的颇为不可思议的可能。“这是…狱寺君？”
得到两人的默认的律同情的看着已经没人样儿了的某未来忠犬，捂脸。
无比忧伤。他家可爱的正太哥哥怎么就会变成了一个暴力狂啊…
然后一个十分不合时宜的声音响起。
“啊咧，这不是阿纲吗？还有阿律，小婴儿，以及…一具木乃伊？”
承认吧山本君，你才是终极腹黑大BoSS吧…
随后一直没有出声的某傲娇终于炸毛，声音听上去咬牙切齿。
“你才是木乃伊，我只是包扎了一下而已，哪里像木乃伊了？”
某律弱弱的在心里说了一句，哪里都像啊...
看着山本惊讶了几秒，恍然大悟之后又要开口，看到那已经张开的嘴律闭了闭眼，千万不要是我想的那样吧…
然后那个声音伴着爽朗的笑声再次响起，“哪里都像啊！”
于是这句话成为了压死骆驼的最后一根稻草，也成为狱寺君一生中挥之不去的噩梦。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Tutor 3
I have to say that I feel that this tutor who comes out of nowhere and talks about the Italian Mafia, Vongola and other weird things is a veritable scourge!
First of all, his cute little brother asked to sleep with Reborn last night, and the unscrupulous baby agreed without hesitation, and even generously found a suitable position in Ritsu's arms...
Secondly, today, Ritsu got up before dawn and went to make a lunch for Reborn... and he, who always slept well, didn't close his eyes all night, so he naturally discovered...
A Gang, who was full of resentment, had big dark circles under his eyes and his whole person was listless. Even his favorite seaweed soup for breakfast failed to make him feel better.
Lu Ziran noticed the atmosphere around Gang, which was so strong that it was difficult to ignore...
So he greeted with concern, "Brother, did you sleep well last night? I made a bento, which is my favorite shrimp sushi!"
A Tsuna had calmed down a bit after hearing Ritsu's concern. When he heard that the bento was for him and it was his favorite shrimp sushi, he immediately finished adding blood and his whole face became radiant.
Then when I saw that Reborn also had a meal, I felt that it was not enough to affect my good mood.
Seeing that Tsuna was finally back to normal, Ritsu finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Thinking that a certain silver-haired loyal dog was about to arrive, and that Tsuna was about to run naked for the first time, Ritsu unconsciously showed a smirk. Ah, I’m really looking forward to it~
Sure enough, I have a bit of a bad taste~ However, being happy physically and mentally is good for your health, right?
As expected, Molu, who was in the same class as Tsuna, met his dear loyal dog prison temple.
Looking at the awkward-looking young man on the podium, the corner of Ritsu's mouth curled up in an evil arc. He and A Gang were seated very close to each other now, but one was in the middle and the other was by the window.
Sa, dear young man, how do you choose? Find Tsuna Sawada among two people who look exactly the same.
Don't let me down.
Jade Temple did not take any direct action, but went to class as usual. With a look of impatience on his face, he waited until get out of class was over and all the students left before standing up.
Yudera looked around and finally settled on Lu and A Gang. He did not move forward impetuously, but observed the two of them, and finally came to a conclusion and walked straight towards Liu.
Lu was a little disappointed. Did he think wrong?
But the next movement of Jokudera who walked in front of him made the corner of his mouth curl up.
Jokudera quickly restrained Ritsu's hands and put a knife against his neck.
Then he said to the panicked Tsuna, "Sawada Tsunayoshi, duel me behind the school. If you don't agree..."
The knife in his hand moved a little closer to Lu's neck, scratching the delicate skin a little, and a trace of blood slid down the graceful neck. Ritsu looked indifferent, since it didn't hurt much anyway, and he carefully noticed that Gokudera's hand had moved outward in an inconspicuous way. It seemed that the injury to him was unintentional.
Besides, it would be easy for him to break away from the skylark that he has been fighting with for three days, and even letting him restrain him was deliberate. Well, it doesn’t mean anything special. I’m just too bored right now and want to watch a show...
It is impossible for Yudera to do anything to harm Tsuna, so Ritsu is not worried. Anyway, Tsuna will impress Jokudera, and then he will continue on the path of a loyal dog...
So when he saw Tsuna who was about to rush over, Ritsu still had a reassuring smile.
"Don't worry, brother, it's okay."
A Gang stopped, gritted his teeth and said, "Let go of Xiao Lu, I promise you."
Reborn appeared from the wall and his cute face turned gloomy instantly when he saw the blood on Ritsu's neck.
He originally wanted the Prison Temple to be A Gang's guardian and create an opportunity for A Gang to hone his skills. However, heHe actually hurt the law...
Reborn didn't know what position this young man who was always busy with him occupied in his heart. At first, he felt that it was impossible for Ritsu to be kind to him for no reason, so he racked his brains to think about what he could get from him. But no matter how he thought about it, the result pointed to a fact that he had never wanted to admit and did not believe there would be - that is, this boy really just liked himself and tried his best to do something for himself.
He didn't know and didn't want to think about what this person meant to him now, but one thing was undeniable - he didn't want to see him get hurt.
And Yuji actually hurt him... Reborn felt that he hadn't been this angry for a long time, and few things or people could make his peaceful heart fluctuate too much, but obviously, this boy who didn't spend much time with him did it.
Jokudera is indeed an excellent candidate to be the guardian of Arashi, but before that... let's play with him for a while...
So, let us shed a few tears of sympathy for the poor Jokudera-kun in advance...
After hearing A Tsuna's consent, Yudera let go of Ritsu, and then said neatly, "I'm sorry, I didn't control my strength well."
Lu helplessly looked at A Gang, whose anger level was rising, and held his forehead helplessly.
I said Jokudera-kun, although I know you are telling the truth and you really want to apologize, can't you stop being so awkward... Saying this with an expressionless face really seems like a provocation. Hey, haven't you noticed that Tsuna's eyes are so "hot" when he looks at you?
However, Molu, who was a little injured, was still very bad-hearted and did not intend to explain this fact. Although he wanted to see the scene of bombs flying all over the sky, he was worried that it would be bad if he was affected again. There were still many opportunities to watch the show. He had to go to the infirmary for disinfection and extort a few more band-aids...
He said goodbye to Gang and the others and left. So when he came out of the infirmary and was about to go home with Gang and Reborn, he saw a humanoid mummy in great horror.
Looking at the refreshed Gang and the smiling Reborn, Ritsu hesitated to say a possibility that he found quite incredible. "This is...Jokudera-kun?"
Having received the acquiescence of both of them, Lu looked sympathetically at a certain future loyal dog who had lost all appearance, and covered her face.
Extremely sad. How could his lovely brother Shota turn into a violent maniac...
Then a very inappropriate voice sounded.
"Ah, isn't this A Gang? There's also Alu, a baby, and...a mummy?"
Admit it, Yamamoto-kun, you are the ultimate shady boss...
Then a certain tsundere who had been silent for a long time finally broke out, her voice sounding like she was gritting her teeth.
"You are the mummy. I just bandaged it. How do you look like a mummy?"
Moulu weakly said in his heart, it looks like it everywhere...
I looked at Yamamoto in surprise for a few seconds, then suddenly realized that he was about to speak again. When I saw the already opened mouth, I closed my eyes. It must not be what I thought...
Then the voice sounded again with hearty laughter, "It looks like it everywhere!"
So this sentence became the last straw that broke the camel's back, and also became the lingering nightmare in Jokudera-kun's life.
